sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The queen of the forest elves. Lefina had the power to purify sickness and evil, which is why many were taken with her noble nature. Although she wished to unite many races and tribes in a coalition that would help them thrive together, her perspective failed to change how the elves despised the neighboring shapeshifting tribe, as she had only recently been crowned queen and her influence had yet to spread. However, once a mysterious man from a certain organization appeared and offered her his help, she was happy to oblige to his requests thinking that they would ultimately help her own cause.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Forest Queen Lefina |bf2 = true }} '''Lefina''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== The queen of the forest elves. Lefina had the power to purify sickness and evil, which is why many were taken with her noble nature. Although she wished to unite many races and tribes in a coalition that would help them thrive together, her perspective failed to change how the elves despised the neighboring shapeshifting tribe, as she had only recently been crowned queen and her influence had yet to spread. However, once a mysterious man from a certain organization appeared and offered her his help, she was happy to oblige to his requests thinking that they would ultimately help her own cause. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Lefina |element = Light |image1 = Navi chara bf2 60 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 60 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 60 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 60 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 60 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 60 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 60 6.png |image7note = |image8 = Navi chara bf2 60 7.png |image8note = }} ==Trivia==
